selected_experts.reason: Primary verification that the subject is taxonomically a daisy and not a look-alike (e.g., chamomile or aster).
To detect subtle AI artifacts in petal edges, texture consistency, and the interaction between the insect and the flower.
To ensure individual petals are distinct entities without fusion or bleeding into the background or each other.
To identify the secondary subject (insect) and ensure it doesn't introduce structural anomalies affecting the main class score.

focus_areas: Petal edge sharpness and separation from background
Texture consistency of the yellow disc florets
Structural integrity of the insect (no extra limbs/melting)
Lighting consistency between flower and insect
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the insect on the flower. While the class is 'daisy', AI generators often struggle with small interacting objects like insects. Check if the insect's legs merge with the flower disc or if its anatomy is nonsensical. Also, verify that the white petals do not have 'halo' artifacts against the green background.
